Success here means thinking ahead - identifying issues with scale, security, or compliance before they affect services. You've proven the database and compute platform can handle 10x current traffic volumes by working with backend teams to stress-test it. You've cut deploy times in half by rethinking how the pipeline works. You've tested multi-region failover under realistic failure scenarios and it worked. You've redesigned service discovery to remove networking issues that used to cause weekly firefights. review_candidates.title: Senior Cybersecurity Engineer
review_candidates.description: About the Role We are looking for a Senior Cybersecurity Specialist to own our information security program across all domains. This is a broad, strategic role for someone with deep experience across the full security landscape — threat intelligence, risk management, IAM, defensive tools, security operations, and compliance — with a strong track record in regulated financial services environments. You will assess our current security posture, define the policies and standards that govern every security domain, select and recommend the right defensive tools, manage information security risk, and define how our security operations function should run. What You Will Do Threat Intelligence •     Monitor the threat landscape relevant to Egyptian financial services — CBE advisories, regional threat actors, financial sector attack trends, and emerging attack vectors. •     Translate threat intelligence into actionable security measures — updated controls, policy changes, tool configurations, and team awareness. •     Produce regular threat intelligence briefings for the CIO and leadership — clear, business-language risk summaries, not technical reports. •     Maintain awareness of vulnerabilities affecting the organization’s technology stack and drive timely remediation. Development Security & Secure SDLC Conduct source code reviews to identify security vulnerabilities, insecure coding patterns, and compliance gaps across development projects Perform penetration testing on applications, APIs, and infrastructure to identify exploitable weaknesses before deployment Review architecture designs of newly developed environments and systems to ensure security controls are embedded from design through deployment Own end-to-end implementation of security controls across the solution lifecycle — from development and testing through production release Partner with development teams to embed secure coding practices and threat modeling into the SDLC Validate that third-party and in-house developed solutions meet GlobalCorp's security and regulatory (FRA) requirements prior to go-live Document findings from code reviews and penetration tests, track remediation, and verify closure with development teams. Defensive Tools & Technology Assessment •     Assess the organization’s current security tool landscape — identify gaps, overlaps, and opportunities to consolidate or upgrade. •     Evaluate, recommend, and define requirements for security tools across all domains: SIEM, EDR, WAF, DLP, PAM, vulnerability management, email security, and network detection. •     Define tool selection criteria aligned to budget, regulatory requirements, integration capability, and operational maturity. •     Oversee the deployment and configuration standards for all security tools — ensuring they are correctly implemented by the operational team. •     Stay current on the security vendor market — evaluate new technologies and make evidence-based recommendations to the CIO. Identity & Access Management (IAM) •     Define the organization’s IAM strategy — covering authentication standards, MFA enforcement, privileged access governance, and role-based access control. •     Establish policies for joiners, movers, and leavers — ensuring access is provisioned, modified, and revoked in a timely and auditable manner. •     Define Privileged Access Management (PAM) requirements — identify privileged accounts, define access review cycles, and set standards for just-in-time access. •     Review and approve IAM implementations — ensuring identity controls meet the defined policy standards across all systems and platforms.   Security Operations & Incident Response Monitor security events via SIEM, investigate alerts, and lead incident response (containment, eradication, recovery) Conduct digital forensics and root-cause analysis on security incidents Maintain and test incident response playbooks ·      Define what good security operations look like for the organization — SOC requirements, monitoring scope, alert tiers, escalation paths, and SLA targets. ·      Design and document incident response procedures and playbooks for all major scenario types — ransomware, data breach, account compromise, DDoS, insider threat. ·      Define the requirements for managed SOC services or internal SOC capability — monitoring coverage, tooling integration, reporting cadence, and performance metrics. ·      Conduct periodic tabletop exercises and incident response simulations — test readiness and identify gaps in procedures. ·      Own the organization’s vulnerability management program — define scanning scope, remediation SLAs, exception processes, and reporting. Vulnerability Management Run regular vulnerability scans across infrastructure, applications, and endpoints Prioritize and track remediation with asset owners, report on risk exposure trends What We Are Looking For Experience •     6 to 10 years of information security experience with a clear track record across multiple security domains — not just one specialization. •     Proven experience building or significantly maturing a security program — policy frameworks, risk registers, tool assessments, and operational definitions. •     Experience assessing and recommending security tools across multiple categories — you have evaluated vendors, written requirements, and advised on selection decisions. •     Experience managing security risk at an organizational level — not just technical risk, but business-facing risk communication and treatment planning. Knowledge & Skills •     Broad knowledge across all major security domains — network security, endpoint protection, identity and access management, data security, application security, cloud security, and physical security. •     Ability to assess security architecture and technical designs — identify weaknesses, define requirements, and provide structured feedback without needing to implement personally. •     Strong understanding of the security tool landscape — SIEM, EDR, WAF, DLP, PAM, vulnerability management, email security, and network detection and response. •     Excellent written communication — able to produce clear, well-structured security policies, risk reports, and executive briefings in both Arabic and English. •     Strong analytical thinking — able to assess complex security situations, prioritize risks, and recommend pragmatic, proportionate responses. •     Secure Software Development Life Cycle (SSDLC) methodologies and how security gates integrate into Agile/DevOps pipelines •     Application architecture patterns (monolith, microservices, API-driven, cloud-native) and their associated attack surfaces •     Web, mobile, and API security fundamentals Education •     Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Security, Engineering, or a related field. •     Arabic and English fluency — written and spoken.

Deloitte is looking for someone who combines strong technical expertise with curiosity and an ownership mindset. Someone enjoys building new things, collaborating, learning and overcoming challenges. Someone who believes that great infrastructure is about enabling people, improving experience and making an impact that matters. You won’t just be maintaining an infrastructure but helping to shape what is next, can build capabilities, influence how we work and see the direct impact of your contribution. Professional experience in enterprise network and infrastructure environments with strong hands-on expertise in network and security technologies. Proven experience with Palo Alto Networks firewalls and SD-WAN including design, implementation, configuration, troubleshooting and lifecycle management. Strong knowledge and practical experience with Cisco technologies in routing and switching as well as enterprise network architecture. Solid understanding of network security, segmentation, VPN and high availability and resilient network design. Continuous learning and improvement mindset and ability to adapt to business needs evolution. Cisco and Palo Alto certifications English language fluency. Desirables Experience in network automation, scripting and infrastructure as a code. Exposure to cloud networking and hybrid-cloud environments. ITIL certified People management experience Connect to your business – Technology & Transformation Distinctive thinking, deep expertise, and collaborative work. That’s what connects us. That’s what makes us Deloitte. If you want to help solve some of the biggest challenges around, join us. Together, we’ll make an impact on those matters. Personal Independence Regulation and controls are standard practice in our industry and Deloitte is no exception. These controls provide important legal protection for both you and the firm. We are subject to several audit regulations, one of which requires that certain colleagues abide by specific personal independence constraints. This can mean that you and your "Immediate Family Members" are not permitted to hold certain financial interests (shares, funds, bonds etc.) with audit clients of the firm. The recruitment team will provide further details as you progress through the recruitment process. Connect with your colleagues Location: Cairo, Egypt “What attracted me to Deloitte were the endless opportunities and the collective experience of other like-minded individuals. Deloitte’s clients include many of the world’s largest organizations; I wanted to be part of a team that made a difference that I could be proud of.” -Dan, Technology & Transformation “Everyone always says “it’s the people,” and that’s true. Working for a brand you feel proud of feels pretty good too. And you don’t have any stress about fitting into a particular stereotype, because there are so many different types of people in Deloitte Digital.” – Gillian, Technology & Transformation Our commitment to you Making an impact is more than just what we do: it’s why we’re here. So, we work hard to create an environment where you can experience a purpose you believe in, the freedom to be you, and the capacity to go further than ever before. We want you. The true you. Your own strengths, perspective, and personality. So, we’re nurturing a culture where everyone belongs, feels supported and heard, and is empowered to make a valuable, personal contribution. You can be sure we’ll take your wellbeing seriously, too. Because it’s only when you’re comfortable and at your best that you can make the kind of impact you, and we, live for. Your expertise is our capability, so we’ll make sure it never stops growing. Whether it’s from the complex work you do, or the people you collaborate with, you’ll learn every day. Through world-class development, you’ll gain invaluable technical and personal skills. Whatever your level, you’ll learn how to lead. Connect to your next step A career at Deloitte is an opportunity to develop in any direction you choose. Join us and you’ll experience a purpose you can believe in and an impact you can see. You’ll be free to bring your true self to work every day. And you’ll never stop growing, whatever your level.
